title: Scope of Work Table for Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
What a technician may book and perform differs between the call classes of Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The table states, for every class, which kinds of visit can be booked, the paid precision tune-up price, and the limits on repairs.

## Bookable work by call class

| Call class | Paid precision tune-up bookable | Tune-up price per system | Whole-home duct cleaning bookable | Tank water heater repairs booked |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | Yes | $129.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | No | $129.00 | No | Yes |
| Evening Service Call | No | $129.00 | No | Yes |
| Weekend Service Call | Yes | $149.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | No | $129.00 | No | Yes |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | No | $129.00 | No | Yes |

## Repair limits by call class

| Call class | Major repairs performed in this class | Repairs limited to parts carried on the truck | Fee for the return visit to install a part not on the truck | Combustion and carbon monoxide test on every heating call at no charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | Yes | No | $0.00 | Yes |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | Yes | No | $0.00 | Yes |
| Evening Service Call | Yes | Yes | $0.00 | Yes |
| Weekend Service Call | Yes | Yes | $0.00 | Yes |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | No | Yes | $0.00 | Yes |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | No | Yes | $0.00 | Yes |

## Notes on the table

- Major repairs are compressor, evaporator coil, condenser coil, reversing valve and TXV replacement.
- The tune-up price is listed for every class, but a paid precision tune-up can be booked only where the first table shows Yes: the Standard Service Call at $129.00 and the Weekend Service Call at $149.00.
- A return-visit fee of $0.00 means the return visit to install a part not carried on the truck carries no fee in any class.

## Points of judgement

- A paid tune-up asked for on a Saturday is a Weekend Service Call tune-up, priced at $149.00 per system.
- An evening caller who wants whole-home duct cleaning cannot have it booked in the Evening Service Call class; duct cleaning is bookable only in the Standard Service Call and Weekend Service Call classes.
- A compressor replacement is not performed on an Overnight Emergency Service Call or a Holiday Emergency Service Call.
